description: This line plot illustrates the validation performance, measured in BPC (bits per character), of two models—SMoE Validating and SimSMoE Validating—as a function of training steps, which are scaled by a factor of 10^3 and range from 0 to 50,000. The x-axis, labeled “Training Steps (x10³)”, uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 10, spanning from 0 to 50. The y-axis, labeled “BPC”, also uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 2.2. The plot displays two lines: the “SMoE Validating” line is black with a solid line style and cross markers, while the “SimSMoE Validating” line is magenta with a solid line style and diamond markers. Both lines begin at a high BPC value near 2.2 at training step 0, and both exhibit a rapid initial decline. The black line drops from approximately 1.7 BPC at step 10 to a stable value near 1.2 BPC by step 20. The magenta line follows a similar trajectory, starting at approximately 2.2 BPC, dropping to around 1.4 BPC by step 10, and then stabilizing near 1.2 BPC by step 20. After step 20, both lines remain relatively flat, fluctuating slightly around the 1.2 BPC level until the end of the training period at step 50,000.
